simple.meaning: שִׁלְטוֹן (shilṭôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “ruler.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שִׁלְטוֹן (H7984) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 3:2, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁלְטוֹן (H7984) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שִׁלְטוֹן (H7984) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שִׁלְטוֹן (shilṭôwn) / H7984 is traced through Daniel 3:2, Daniel 3:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
